02 / A little flight science

Four forces.
One incredible balance.

In straight, level flight at constant speed, opposing forces balance. Select a force to see what keeps an airplane moving.

Lift is the aerodynamic force perpendicular to the airflow. Wings redirect air and create pressure differences that help support the airplane’s weight.
